report_name: Ablation panel re-derived at an equal estimator budget
question: Does the published localisation survive when every model in the panel is scored at one identical number of trees?
residual_bias_direction: A common budget truncates whichever arm wanted more rounds, almost always the ablation variant here. This protocol is therefore biased towards non-redundancy exactly as the argmax protocol was biased towards redundancy. The two bound the answer; neither settles it.
